item.title: Self-Hosted Network Flow Exporters: softflowd vs fprobe vs pmacct
item.description: Network flow exporters are essential tools for traffic analysis, capacity planning, and security monitoring. They capture packet metadata and export standardized flow records (NetFlow, IPFIX, sFlow) to collectors for analysis. In this guide, we compare three leading open-source flow exporters: softflowd, fprobe, and pmacct.
